title: Senate Armed Services Committee (SASC) on Emerging Threats and Capabilities Briefing 2023
doc_notes: This document is a stenographic transcript of a 2023 Senate Armed Services Committee hearing regarding the mission and activities of the All-Domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO).

incidents.summary: MQ-9 drone observation of a spherical object in the Middle East.
MQ-9 drone observation of an object in South Asia that was initially thought to be anomalous but was later identified as a commuter aircraft.
incidents.explanation: Commuter aircraft; sensor artifact created a false trail.

incidents.summary: PRC high-altitude balloon incursion over North America.
Multiple near-miss incidents involving UAPs and Navy pilots.
